title: UAAP: UST, FEU-Diliman maintain perfect starts in boys' volleyball
summary: University of Santo Tomas and Far Eastern University-Diliman both improved to 3-0 in the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament after beating separate opponents on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym.
